sourcePolicy: Local working tree, tests, diagnostics, scripts, RefPlan5, local Git history and the exact Phase 09 package runtime only; no remote Git.

phaseGate.input: Verified Phase 03 topology, Phase 07 value/liveness/pressure, Phase 12 region, Phase 13 canonical loop/MII and Phase 14 modulo-scheduling witness contracts.
phaseGate.output: A physically isolated, deterministic exact reference oracle for bounded CI/research subjects with typed SAT/UNSAT/UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_LIMIT/INVALID_MODEL results, independently Core-revalidated witnesses, complete comparable UNSAT proofs, deterministic work units and production-to-oracle optimality gaps.
phaseGate.authorityBoundary: Oracle references Core only and is not referenced by Core, Native, LLVM or the legacy production compiler. It cannot mutate Canonical IR, select production code, emit artifacts, legalize runtime execution, publish, commit or retire.
phaseGate.deterministicFallback: Every unresolved lower II, deterministic work-unit exhaustion, watchdog, solver crash, unsupported solver feature, stale proof or invalid model remains unscored and never becomes UNSAT. Production output is unchanged.

oracleContract.search: Complete modulo-time enumeration plus exact integer stage-difference feasibility

restoreOptions.reason: Deterministic local qualification using already pinned dependencies; no vulnerability-service network result participates in the gate.

failures: CompilerPhase01ReadinessSourceScannerTests rejected a raw public bool authority boundary.
CompilerPhase09CleanupMigrationReadinessTests rejected a compiler-facing Validation.IsValid authority-shaped expression.
qualificationHistory.correctiveDisposition: Replaced the bool authority surface with a typed forbidden disposition and made candidate validity depend on the typed validation status; the complete qualification was rerun at the corrective implementation SHA.

releaseDisposition.defaultEnabledScope: Explicit bounded CI/research oracle API only; no production dependency or schedule selection.
releaseDisposition.releaseDisposition: Qualified as Phase 16 bounded-kernel reference evidence only. Production scheduling, modulo expansion and loop transforms remain unchanged and disabled.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Implement semantics-preserving modulo expansion and architecture-driven loop transforms over verified Phase 07 and Phase 13-15 contracts, with exact existing-path fallback and bounded-oracle comparison.
